text: CLI written in Python, single file time_tracker.py
Subcommand 'start <project>' starts a session for a project
Subcommand 'report' shows total time per project
Sessions persisted in a JSON file across invocations
Refuse to start a session while another is active (non-zero exit / error, no new session)
Detect overlapping sessions (e.g. in stored data) and report them
Report aggregates totals correctly per project across multiple sessions
Stop with no active session is handled gracefully with an error (implied)
Corrupt/missing JSON file handled gracefully (implied robustness)
